title: Workspace file
description: `logreq-workspace.yaml` in the root of the main repository (D-041, SR-004). Names the repositories that belong together. Everyone has locally only those they may access; missing ones are shown as not available (N-041, SR-004 AK3). A single-repository workspace lists only itself (SR-004 AK2).

repositories.description: The entry with `main: true` is the repository that holds this file. With two or more repositories exactly one has `main: true`; a single repository is the main one even without it. Names are unique (checked by ReqSeq; JSON Schema cannot express it).

metamodel.description: Where the metamodel lies: a folder in one of the repositories, the main one or its own (D-021, SR-011, SR-018).

evidence.description: Folders with evidence records (Markdown) and JUnit XML files (SR-028 AK1). They may be in repositories of other tools.

baselines.description: Where new baseline files are written. Default: folder `baselines` in the main repository.

filters.description: Where saved filters are written (SR-070). Default: folder `filters` in the main repository.

mappings.description: Where ReqIF mapping files are written (SR-054). Default: folder `reqif` in the main repository.

ignore.description: Glob patterns of paths that are never read as elements, relative to each repository and anchored at its root, with `/` as separator (no `\`, no `//`). `*` matches any characters within one name, `?` one character, `**` as a whole name any number of names, including none; every other character is literal (no `[...]`, no `{a,b}`). Case-sensitive on every OS; wildcards match names starting with `.`. A leading `/` or `./` and a trailing `/` are dropped; `x/**` matches folder `x` itself, so it is skipped as a whole. Example: `website/**`, `**/*.draft.md`. `.git` and `node_modules` are always ignored.

url.description: Address of the repository on the Git server. Informational: ReqSeq never clones or fetches (D-036).

path.description: Expected local location relative to the main repository, with `/` as separator. Default `../<name>`; always `.` for the main repository. Absolute paths and `\` are warned about (an absolute path is ignored); there is no `~` expansion. A person can override it in the untracked file `.logreq/local.yaml`.
